tagline: High sides to curl into, in a coated fabric that mud and wet paws wipe off.
lead: Your dog gets high sides to curl against, and after a muddy walk the bed wipes clean with a cloth.
value: A fleece nest after a wet walk means a wash and a day of drying. This takes a cloth and thirty seconds.
intro: Heron is a waterproof, high-sided nest dog bed with a coated, wipe-clean outer fabric, a cushioned base and a removable zipped cover. Medium, Large and XL.
points: High walls frame the sleeping area on every side.
Mud, drool and wet paws wipe off with a cloth between proper washes.
A cushioned base, so it's a nest rather than a firm foam mattress.
Removable for a deeper clean when it needs one.
best_for: Curled-up sleepers with muddy hobbies, puppies, and older dogs who have the occasional accident.
fit_note: The high sides take up a good part of the outside measurements, so measure your dog curled up and size up if you're between sizes. Not sure? Ask us with their breed and weight.
care: Wipe the coated outer for everyday marks. Check the sewn-in label before washing the removable cover, as detergent and machine washing can affect some waterproof finishes.
seo_title: Waterproof High-Sided Nest Dog Bed, Wipe-Clean | Snoozly
seo_description: A waterproof nest dog bed with high sides to curl into and a coated outer that wipes clean after muddy walks. Cushioned base. Medium, Large and XL.
